items.title: 7.4 Rate law, rate constant aur reaction ka order (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 7.4, printed page 154.

blocks.text: Kisi darja hararat par reaction ki rate ek ya zyada reactants aur products ki concentrations par munhasir ho sakti hai. Agle topics rate law aur rate constant, reaction ka order, order ki qismein, aur rate constant ki units ki tareef karte hain.

blocks.prompt: Reaction ka order us ke balanced muadle se kyun nahi parha ja sakta?
blocks.explanation: Balanced muadla sirf kul stoichiometry, reactants aur products ke mole tanasub, deta hai. Rate mechanism par munhasir hai, khas kar is par ke sab se sust qadam mein kaun si species hissa leti hain, to rate law ke exponents tajurbe se dhoondne hote hain aur coefficients ke barabar ho bhi sakte hain aur nahi bhi.

items: Rate law rate ko tajurbati exponents ke saath concentrations se jorta hai; k rate constant hai aur exponents ka majmooa order (tafseel 7.4.1 se 7.4.4 mein).
